name: Tandoor Recipes
short_description: Self-hosted recipe manager with meal planning and shopping lists.
description: Tandoor Recipes is a self-hosted recipe management app. Import recipes from URLs, organize with tags and books, plan meals for the week, and auto-generate shopping lists based on your meal plan. This covers meal planning and shopping.
usecases: Import and manage recipes from any website automatically.
Plan weekly meals and generate smart grocery lists.
Share recipes with family or cooking community.
